prompt:

First image reference is ONLY fictional adult identity: keep same face, age, skin tone, hair and body proportions. Do not reuse its pixels, pose, clothing, lighting, background or framing. Scene: blue running track with charcoal stadium steps, sharp late-afternoon side light. Pose: front three-quarter forward lunge with hands on hips and clear garment view. High contrast movement, believable athletic body, natural hands, sharp garment detail. Entire person including head and shoes within frame with clear margin; keep person in central 65% width for editorial crops. New front-focused camera angle and new setting, not an edit of the identity image. Wordmark tiny tone-on-tone MORAVEL in condensed uppercase sans like DIN Condensed only at rear waistband of bottoms or left chest/hem of tops. No extra text, logos or watermark. Generate exact wide portrait 4:5, 1122x1402.
REQUIRED CANVAS: EXACT 4:5 aspect ratio, 1122 pixels wide by 1402 pixels tall, or larger 4:5 such as 2048x2560. Compose on a wider 4:5 frame, not a tall 3:4 frame. Add horizontal gym/track/city space around the subject to achieve 4:5. No border. Keep entire shoes and hair within frame. Shorts MUST reach just above knee with 8-inch inseam, not mid-thigh.
